description: VizStock (Building Stock Visualization Platform) (SWR-21-08) is a software deposit deposited in DOE Office of Scientific and Technical Information (OSTI) Repository by its authors Noel Merket, Henry Horsey (National Renewable Energy Lab. (NREL), Golden, CO (United States)). The Building Stock Visualization Platform uses web-based technologies to display information on the input assumptions and output results of building stock modeling tools for building energy audits. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page.
